name: My ga tan
summary: Mỳ gà tần is braised chicken with egg noodles. The chicken, regular or the smaller black-skinned bird, is simmered in an empty drink can with herbs that include mugwort, then the noodles go into the stew.
origin: Hanoi, on Vietnam Tourism’s Hanoi street-food article.
howToEat: Choose the regular chicken or the black-skinned chicken. The black bird costs a little more.
The chickens go into empty soda or beer cans with aromatic herbs, including mugwort. Egg noodles are added to the stew.
where: In Hanoi, the stew is regular chicken or the smaller black-skinned bird.
seoTitle: My ga tan — Hanoi herbal chicken noodles
seoDescription: Mỳ gà tần in Hanoi is braised chicken and egg noodles. Vietnam Tourism describes chicken simmered in a can with mugwort and other herbs.
